name: Food Runner AI
tagline: Plans a food route around your diet, budget and location, learning your tastes over time.

awards: Smart Task Accelerator presented by Grainger

problem: Food planning while travelling is harder than it should be.
solution: Takes preferences and constraints, optimises restaurant stops within a radius on a map, and refines suggestions from repeated use.
demo_moment: Team-described: set a budget and get a route of stops.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Smart Task Accelerator presented by Grainger” among 122 submissions.
Uses multi-constraint optimisation rather than a list.

lessons: Optimise a route, not a ranking.
